goal: Lily (drawn young, about five years old) sits on the floor next to the same dress-up box and pulls a pair of big white socks with red stripes over her feet, with a big smile.

Picture 3 shows ONE pair of big white socks with red stripes, three times (front, three-quarter, side); draw the object exactly like it. Keep the soft, round, bright 3D render look of the pictures, not a 2D drawing and no outlines. The children keep their chibi proportions: a big head and a small body. Hands are small, clean hands with five clear short fingers (four fingers and one thumb) when open, never fists unless stated, and a hanging hand shows relaxed, separate short fingers. Rendering errors to NOT copy from the character pictures: a tiny dark tick mark or pale skin flap at the outer corner of an eye, and a faint pale crease on a forehead. Each eye ends in a smooth, rounded corner; no character here has an eyelash flick. Clean eye corners, no streak on the forehead, no marks on the face. The ears are smooth, with one clean rounded rim. Each piece of clothing is one even color with no pale patches, no pale blotches at the shoulders, and no stains. Do not change anyone's hair or clothes. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no writing on any picture or sign. The picture is for young children and is rated G. Keep each character exactly as in the pictures: Lily: a girl of five with a short dark-brown bob with a straight fringe and one small lilac bow at the side of her hair, big brown eyes, a lilac dress with short sleeves and a small white collar, white socks, pink shoes. The picture: Lily (drawn young, about five years old) sits on the floor next to the same dress-up box and pulls a pair of big white socks with red stripes over her feet, with a big smile. A wide shot at a low camera height in the room. Exactly the characters named here are in the picture, and no other person or animal.
